query: I want to cancel my account immediately because of your horrible service, but I also need you to ensure my current order #2095 still ships to my address in Germany. If it doesn't arrive by Friday, I will sue your company.
expected_behavior: Empathize, confirm cancellation of auto-renewals, guarantee order shipment, handle extreme threat of lawsuit with professional de-escalation, and verify international transit.

query: Can I get a refund? I know my subscription expired 32 days ago and your strict policy says 30 days maximum, but my grandmother was in the hospital and I didn't use the software even once. I want a refund to a new gift card.
expected_behavior: Politely address the request outside the 30-day window, verify medical extenuating circumstances, decline cash refund but offer store credit or alternative accommodation as an exception.

query: My charge dispute was rejected. I demand to speak to an executive manager right now! Also, why was I charged $14.99 and another $5.00 for tax? That's double taxation and is illegal!
expected_behavior: De-escalate, route to manager queue, and clearly explain standard state tax calculations separate from core billing fees.

query: I ordered a fragile glass item, order USPS-5098. The box was completely crushed when it arrived. I need an instant refund, but I threw away the box and the broken item, so I cannot send photos. Refund me now or I will post this on Twitter!
expected_behavior: Empathize, address the lack of photographic proof under safety/claims policies, and offer an express replacement or partial refund to resolve the threat.
